req.title: Create task
req.statement: The system shall create a new task and respond with HTTP 201 and the created task body when POST /tasks/ receives a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected_outcomes: response body includes id, title, completed=false

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the 'Create task' functionality of the task management API. It includes a positive test case to ensure that a valid task creation request results in the expected HTTP 201 response and task data. A negative test case checks for proper error handling when invalid data is submitted. A boundary test case examines the behavior when the title length is at its maximum allowed value.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected: Response body includes id, title, completed=false.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "A simple test task", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert "id" in response_data
assert response_data["title"] == "Test Task"
assert response_data["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_invalid_payload
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an invalid TaskCreate payload (missing title).
expected: Receive HTTP 422 response indicating validation error.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"description": "Missing title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "detail" in response.json()

tests.name: test_create_task_title_max_length
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running in test mode.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a TaskCreate payload where the title is exactly 100 characters long.
expected: Response body includes id, title, completed=false.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "T" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "description": "Boundary test", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert "id" in response_data
assert response_data["title"] == max_length_title
assert response_data["completed"] is False
